ORDINANCE II OF 1998
An Ordinance further to amend the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 7th February, 1998]
No.S.LEGIS:1(2)/98, dated
7-2-1998.--The following Ordinance made by the Government of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Karachi Development
Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998.
(2) It shall come into force on
and from 31st March, 1997.

Amendment of Article 52-A of K.D.A. Order V of 1957

ORDINANCE II OF 1998
KARACHI
DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE II OF 1998
An Ordinance further to amend the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 7th February, 1998]
No.S.LEGIS:1(2)/98, dated
7-2-1998.--The following Ordinance made by the Government of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of Article 52-A
of K.D.A. Order V of 1957.-----In the Karachi Development Authority Order,
1957, in Article 52-A, in clause (2), the full stop at the end shall be
replaced by a semi-colon and thereafter the following proviso shall be
added:--"
"Provided that any amenity plot vesting in the Karachi
Transport Corporation may, with prior approval of Government, be converted to
or utilized for any other purpose.".
